about.text: Japanese link-directory site (WordPress) collecting LoL resources by section: official sites and YouTube, wikis (LoLJPWiki), esports (Esports Charts), blogs and news (Game 4 Broke, SejuPoro, LoL Ninja, lol-cla), stats/databases (OP.GG, DEEPLOL, MOBAFire, LoLMeta, U.GG, YOUR.GG, LOLSTARZ, LoLBuild.JP, LoLalytics, LOLKING, Blitz, ONETRICKER.GG, YearIn.LoL), tools (blitz.gg, zeal.gg), streams and skin/sound sites; has a changelog and about page.

coverage.text: Directory sections: official, wiki, esports, blogs, stats DBs, tools, streaming/video, skins and sounds, quick links
